node.title: DLI ell=2 weight-5 pair router admits an exact cyclotomic ideal-index obstruction
node.statement: For each legal normalized router pair at order M, clear the two final-pair membership equations to elements F,G of Z[zeta_M]. If the block multiplication matrix L=[M_F M_G] has full rational row rank, its maximal determinantal divisor Delta=[Z[zeta_M]:(F,G)] is divisible by every split-row characteristic supporting that pair. Delta is invariant under odd Galois dilation. Hence the official (ell,w)=(2,5) slot has an exact finite certificate: one pair per odd-dilation orbit at M=1024 and exclusion of every Delta factor q<2^256 with v_2(q-1)>=41. The reduction is proved; that production certificate is not yet complete.
